  {"step": 1, "file": "bin/fribidi-fuzzer.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 32, "var": "data/size", "code": "const FriBidiStrIndex str_len = size / 4; FriBidiChar *str = (FriBidiChar *) data;", "note": "Attacker-controlled bytes are reinterpreted as an array of 4-byte FriBidiChar values. The input contains isolate control characters (LRI 0x2066, RLI 0x2067, FSI 0x2068, PDI 0x2069) and embedding characters (LRE/RLE/LRO/RLO/PDF) that drive run construction."},
  {"step": 2, "file": "bin/fribidi-fuzzer.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 40, "var": "types", "code": "fribidi_get_bidi_types (str, str_len, types);", "note": "Each input character is classified into a bidi type (isolate/embedding/neutral/strong), producing the types array consumed by the embedding-levels resolver."},
  {"step": 3, "file": "bin/fribidi-fuzzer.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 41, "var": "btypes", "code": "fribidi_get_bracket_types (str, str_len, types, btypes);", "note": "Bracket types are computed; the input contains no brackets so all runs carry FRIBIDI_NO_BRACKET, which is required for the merge condition in compact_neutrals to hold."},
  {"step": 4, "file": "bin/fribidi-fuzzer.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 43, "var": "level", "code": "fribidi_get_par_embedding_levels_ex (types, btypes, str_len, &par_type, levels);", "note": "Entry into the vulnerable resolver. It builds a linked list of FriBidiRun objects (each allocated by new_run) and then compacts/merges runs."},
  {"step": 5, "file": "lib/fribidi-run.c", "function": "new_run", "line": 44, "var": "run", "code": "run = fribidi_malloc (sizeof (FriBidiRun));", "note": "Each text run is heap-allocated. Runs carry next/prev, next_isolate/prev_isolate, level, and isolate_level fields. The isolate pointers form a separate isolating-sequence linked list used later by get_adjacent_run."},
  {"step": 6, "file": "lib/fribidi-bidi.c", "function": "compact_neutrals", "line": 1216, "var": "list", "code": "compact_neutrals (main_run_list);", "note": "ROOT CAUSE: compact_neutrals merges adjacent runs when RL_LEVEL and RL_TYPE match, but it does NOT compare RL_ISOLATE_LEVEL. Two runs that belong to different isolating sequences (different isolate_level) can therefore be merged, corrupting the isolate pointer graph."},
  {"step": 7, "file": "lib/fribidi-bidi.c", "function": "compact_neutrals", "line": 127, "var": "list", "code": "if (RL_LEVEL (list->prev) == RL_LEVEL (list) && ((RL_TYPE (list->prev) == RL_TYPE (list) || ...))) list = merge_with_prev (list);", "note": "The merge predicate is satisfied for a pair of adjacent runs that have equal embedding level and equal/neutral type but DIFFERENT isolate_level. The missing RL_ISOLATE_LEVEL check lets merge_with_prev run on runs from distinct isolating sequences."},
  {"step": 8, "file": "lib/fribidi-bidi.c", "function": "merge_with_prev", "line": 96, "var": "second", "code": "fribidi_free (second);", "note": "merge_with_prev frees the second run. Because the two runs had different isolate_level, the freed run is still reachable as next_isolate/prev_isolate from another run in a different isolating sequence, leaving a dangling pointer in the isolate graph."},
  {"step": 9, "file": "lib/fribidi-bidi.c", "function": "fribidi_get_par_embedding_levels_ex", "line": 1237, "var": "ppp_prev", "code": "ppp_prev = get_adjacent_run(pp, false, false);", "note": "During N1+N2 neutral resolution, get_adjacent_run is called for each run. It follows the (now corrupted) prev_isolate pointer of a run, which points to the run freed in step 8."},
  {"step": 10, "file": "lib/fribidi-bidi.c", "function": "get_adjacent_run", "line": 156, "var": "ppp", "code": "FriBidiCharType ppp_type = RL_TYPE (ppp);", "note": "MEMORY-SAFETY SINK: ppp is the dangling pointer to the freed run. RL_TYPE(ppp) performs a 4-byte READ from freed heap memory, triggering the AddressSanitizer heap-use-after-free WRITE/READ report (issue 42497421)."}
]
EOF
